title: How Chime is redefining marketing through AI
summary: Chime CMO Vineet Mehra shares how AI is reshaping marketing into an agent-driven model and why leaders who prioritize AI literacy and thoughtful adoption will drive growth.
body: Chime CMO Vineet Mehra shares how AI is reshaping marketing into an agent-driven model and why leaders who prioritize AI literacy and thoughtful adoption will drive growth.
summaryZh: Chime CMO分享了如何通过AI重塑营销模式，强调了AI素养对企业增长的重要性。文章主要探讨了企业管理层如何利用AI驱动业务转型，而非深入的技术分析。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该文章主要讨论营销理念的转型，缺乏关于AI智能体技术实现的实质性细节。
